author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Four beepers are scattered along the row. Sweep them up and leave the whole pile on the last corner.
brief.es: Hay cuatro zumbadores repartidos por la fila. Recógelos todos y deja la pila entera en la última esquina.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
        BEGIN
            WHILE next-to-a-beeper DO
                pickbeeper;
            move
        END
        WHILE next-to-a-beeper DO
            pickbeeper;
        WHILE beeper-in-bag DO
            putbeeper;
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
